text_block_list.text:
The sun rises on the Japanese Derby.
Feeling the
weight of my dream and the
crowd's on her
shoulders, Rudolf is
understandably a little
uptight.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I help her recover her composure, and
the
Emperor takes to the track calm,
collected, and
with her ideals held high.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
